findings.claim: The pilot successfully falsified and repaired external-reference granularity without allowing Ordivon owner theory to mint external identities.
Network now has direct bounded mapping to Networking and Communication; the prior generic Computation/Information adjacency is no longer used as a substitute.
Runtime has bridge-level mapping to Computer Systems Fundamentals and Operating Systems, but whole-field computing-systems coverage remains explicitly unclaimed.

World maps directly to a bounded Metaphysics subspace and bridges Philosophy of Science; Normative bridges Ethics & Value Theory. The new Philosophy region removes the prior Mind-region navigation false positive.

The current seven-owner pilot still has no direct mapping to Physics, Chemistry, Earth/Planetary, Biology, Genetics, Cognitive Science, Psychology or Linguistics; excluded unpublished owners prevent interpreting that as whole-Ordivon absence.
